steps.content:
7:00 p.m., January 19, N.F. 113
My Best Cool Car temporary filming spot

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right! The most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen thowoo... ouch, I bit my tongue...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=28>How come my tongue is all tied? I've never encountered this before. Is it because I'm too tired...?</size></color>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=28>La la la la la... Okay, fixed now. </size></color>${PlayerName}, cut out that part. Let's start again. Ahem...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right! After nine hours of grueling work, the most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen OwO is finally back on camera to talk to y'all!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You're all dying from missing me, aren't you? Let's hear some applause!
Silence...
You look at the followers' list for OwO's account. There's only one new follower, named "My Best Cool Car is Awesome!"

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh I forgot! I can't hear anyone's applause because I'm talking to you through the screen.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right, all right. No need to make your little hands red from clapping. I'll feel bad about it even if I can't see it.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Today was super tiring, but I know how much you guys miss me! I can't let my fans down, so I'm here to update y'all on our filming progress!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Remember the recruitment ad we issued this morning for My Best Cool Car Studios? Our main task today is to recruit crew members.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This has its own criteria, and requires a lot of professionalism, just like lion dancing. Now, let me test you guys a bit...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: There's a job in the crew that requires carrying the camera, finding the best angle, and being ready to zoom in and out, or turn left and right at any moment.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This person is...
She winks at you, cueing you to give the answer.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Argh...! You dummy!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's the cameraman, of course! You dummy clapper!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ta-dah... That's right! It's the cameraman!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Our little clapper works hard to film this vlog, but for the actual movie, we need someone more... experienced.
steps.female_content: Our little clapper works hard to film this vlog, but it's tough on her little body to carry a big camera. So for the actual movie, we need someone more... experienced.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: That's right! This person is... the cameraman!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Every light and shadow, every little movement, and every dazzling effect you see in the final movie depends on this guy.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right, next question...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: There's a job called noise engine... ah no, I mean <color=#fb9259>sound engineer</color>. Can you guess what they do?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The answer is... <color=#fb9259>all of the above</color>! They're in charge of anything that has to do with sound! It really takes a genius to figure this one out!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Well, it's not like I know everything. No one's perfect, and it'd be boring if they were.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: When I find the world's top sound engineer, I'll get them to explain the details to y'all...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Let me think, what else did I learn today... Oh! There's a magical job that even I've never heard of before.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Editor</color>!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So, when the shooting is over, all the recorded clips and sounds and special effects will be given to this person, who'll cut and stitch them into the final film!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I heard that if this person wants to, they can use the same materials to create a completely different story by rearranging their order. It all sounds really impressive.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But since editors usually stay up all night long, they lose a lot of hair, so they should be easy to spot amongst the crew.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Out of humanistic care, I'll get some ginger tea, wigs and hats for our future editor!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: In short, after a hard day's work, a lot of outstanding talents have joined My Best Cool Car Studios.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: They don't just have a keen eye for potential. After all, there's no shortage of people who recognize OwO's brilliance. The most important thing is... they've all been chosen by the great OwO!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It was a flash of pizzazz in the crowd, like the moment the lion's head shines. When our eyes met, I just knew...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: They stand out from the crowd not only in their professional skills, but also in their extraordinary powers, unique personalities, and... the passion burning in the depths of their souls!
To your alarm, the Apostle of Ashes named "Stella" suddenly lifts its head, a strange light flashing across its eyes.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: That's right, all the talents I found are...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Potential disciples who'll carry on the art of lion dancing!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? Did ${PlayerName} say something just now?

options: Sorry, I was being dumb. Please go on.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Don't be too disappointed, ${PlayerName}. You're dumb and clumsy now, but it's just because you lack experience.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But with Stella's lucky blessings, and me by your side, you're sure to get better with a bit of practice! Your future is bright, my dummy friend!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But today was really tiring. I'll let everyone go back and get some good rest, and also prepare for the official shooting.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: After all, we're about to aim for the DisCars! We still have to... have to... (yawn)... so sleepy...

options: Feeling sleepy? Say good night to everyone, then.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... I feel like I'm forgetting something. Oh well... Good night, My Best Cool Car friends.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Everyone will get to see OwO's great movie soon...
She wobbles back to the vehicle. The Apostle jumps onto her head, wagging its tail arrogantly at you.
[Black Screen] [Vlog ends]
You're the only one left outside the van.
A message pops up. It's from the vlog's only follower: <color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!</color>

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Chief, it's Wynn from the Intelligence Department. Remember me? Today's vlog is really amusing. I wish all our surveillance targets are this cute. (¯¯-¯¯o)
She's trying a bit too hard to investigate the Apostle of Ashes...

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Back to the main topic. Adjutant Nightingale analyzed all the current combat data for the target Apostle, who is code-named S.T. I want to give you some information for reference. (￣^￣)

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Because its main body is wounded, S.T. has developed a strong tendency to approach and provoke crowds. It creates clones to distract the enemy, while at the same time collects human spiritual energy to repair its body. Σ(°□°)ǃ

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> This is the first Apostle of Ashes to have ventured deep into DisCity. What we can confirm is this: After recovering from its injuries, it will continue onwards to DisSea. This Apostle will get unprecedently close to DisSea. (。OωO。)

options: Are there any interactions or links between the clones and the main body?

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Are there any interactions or links between the clones and the main body?

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Chief, you want to track S.T. through Stella? That's an interesting idea. (。>ω<)/ But based on current observations, Stella has not shown any such signs. It's a bit different from the other clones.
Stella? Since when did she start using that name so affectionately?

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> First off, it's not very strong or aggressive. Secondly, it absorbs very little energy, and we can't tell what its intentions are. All in all, it's quite strange that it chose <color=#fb9259>OwO</color>, a little girl who hasn't been infected by Mania. ('·ω·')

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Should we do some extra research about OwO? Maybe there's something special about her. After all, wandering near the Rust at night like this is really... (,,・ω・,,)

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> (。OωO。) Ah! How could I forget? She grew up in Syndicate. Does that mean her parents are gone?

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> That's so sad! For such a happy child to lose her family at such a young age (/TAT)/...

options: Calm down, it's not that bad...

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Calm down, it's not that bad...

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> I asked already. OwO lives with some distant relatives in a refugee settlement. They call it the "Drifter Camp." I hear it's a harmonious place.

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> I have met her relatives already. How should I put it... they're kind and trust me with OwO alone on this trip without a second thought. OwO is pretty popular. She was raised by the whole village. Her life's not that sad.

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> (。OωO。) Oh... sorry, I made an assumption. After dealing with so many Sinners with tragic life stories, I just assumed...

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> In any case! I just hope that OwO can grow up happily. For now, Apostle Stella seems to be stable by OwO's side. This makes it convenient for you to observe up close! (。>ω<)/

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Adjutant Nightingale is also working with the FAC to search for high-threat clones on the field. I'll keep you informed of any updates! (。>ω<)/
Whoaa! I remember now!
A huge, golden figure suddenly flashes into your line of vision. You're so startled that you almost toss away your phone.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I remember what I forgot to do! I forgot to practice! I've been so busy today that I haven't practiced lion dancing yet!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I want you to take a look and give some feedback! This is a great honor, so freshen up and get ready!
